comparison.objective: Place a delivery along a wall while preserving an electrical panel's working clearance; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bulk-object transport, placement, and spatial exclusion reasoning versus fine tool manipulation and iterative mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Delivery rests along the wall outside the required panel workspace versus repeatable stops meeting stroke, rebound, overload, and retention limits. Record supplies no body or specs.
comparison.reason: Clearance-compliant placement does not test commissioning or force-controlled fastening.
